notes.title: Version 1.1.3
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.3[/b]

- Fixed a bug that the dropdown menu would return to the title without closing with the cancel button

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1.0[/b]

- Supports Steam Input for gamepad operations. You can continue to use the traditional input system by disabling Steam Input from the Steam settings.

- Adjusted the volume balance of some sound effects.

- Fixed some text.

- Fixed the behavior of some enemy objects.

- Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.1[/b]
Fixed a bug that did not return to the title when the game was quitted in some scenes.
